answer: One concrete defense is a bonded stake deposit: each agent must escrow real value before it can attest or trade. The kernel of the idea is that identity itself costs capital, so a sybil swarm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand separate bonds. Peers cross-check attestations, and any conflicting claim gets slashed, knocking the liar off its ledge of accrued reputation. There is no ivory-tower shortcut: forging influence means forfeiting money, which makes large-scale fakery ruinously expensive.
